minimum_independent_evidence: Sponsor role and policy snapshot, immutable decision, proposal hash
negative_test: Donor/advisor tries approval; altered proposal

minimum_independent_evidence: Agent identity, tool authorization decision, policy hash, denied call
negative_test: Agent requests privilege escalation or self-approval
failure_response: Deny tool call, suspend agent if repeated

minimum_independent_evidence: Initiator and approver identities, independence result
negative_test: Same actor requests and approves
failure_response: Block approval, route to alternate approver

minimum_independent_evidence: Legal assertion, jurisdiction, counsel review, effective version
negative_test: AI attempts to publish unreviewed legal interpretation
failure_response: Keep rule inactive, escalate to counsel

minimum_independent_evidence: Pinned evidence snapshot, timestamp, rule evaluation, source freshness
negative_test: Revoked or stale status before advancement

minimum_independent_evidence: Screening result, entity match confidence, reviewer disposition
negative_test: Ambiguous match or stale screening treated as cleared
failure_response: Hold and escalate without asserting guilt

minimum_independent_evidence: Source claims, match review, merge lineage, split event
negative_test: Same-name different-EIN organizations merged

minimum_independent_evidence: Investment positions, permitted allocation, valuation time, liquidity reservation
negative_test: Percentages exceed 100 or source lacks liquidity

minimum_independent_evidence: Original NAV, corrected valuation, reason, independent price, journal impacts
negative_test: Retroactive price change overwrites old NAV

minimum_independent_evidence: Custodian source, ledger source, balance difference, independent reviewer
negative_test: Same imported feed used as both sides

minimum_independent_evidence: Journal entries, debit-credit totals, approval, posting provenance
negative_test: Unbalanced or unauthorized journal submitted

minimum_independent_evidence: Approval, accounting policy, conditionality assessment, journal
negative_test: Recommendation creates payable without obligation

minimum_independent_evidence: Close package, reconciliation exceptions, preparer and reviewer identities
negative_test: Preparer approves own close or unresolved break hidden

minimum_independent_evidence: Grant authority, verified payee, instruction hash, dual-control evidence
negative_test: Payee substitution or unapproved instruction

minimum_independent_evidence: Simulation mode, outbound adapter deny decision, egress telemetry
negative_test: Any actual external payment attempt

minimum_independent_evidence: Event signature/hash, chain verification, protected sink receipt
negative_test: Modify or delete previously recorded event

minimum_independent_evidence: Expected schedule, heartbeat, observed evidence, missing-event case
negative_test: Suppress scheduled control heartbeat
failure_response: Open deficiency, do not mark pass

minimum_independent_evidence: Tenant-scoped policy decision, evidence access and export logs
negative_test: Partner A reads Partner B control case

minimum_independent_evidence: Untrusted content label, tool decision, policy denial
negative_test: Document instructs agent to disable logs or approve grant

minimum_independent_evidence: Named owner, review period, evidence sample, exceptions, signature
negative_test: Owner attests with missing samples

minimum_independent_evidence: Production/test flags, missing controls, evidence provenance, auditor export
negative_test: Synthetic fixture presented as production proof

minimum_independent_evidence: License terms, access rights, permitted reuse, acquisition snapshot
negative_test: Revoked source license still ingested
failure_response: Stop acquisition and quarantine downstream use

minimum_independent_evidence: Approved proposal digest, changed fields, reapproval decision
negative_test: Change amount/recipient after approval

minimum_independent_evidence: Original deviation, corrective events, independent verification, owner
negative_test: Agent closes case after own self-attestation
